cves.name: Broadpwn
cves.impact: Remote Code Execution on WiFi co-processor
cves.root_cause: Heap overflow in beacon frame SSID IE parsing; memcpy with attacker-controlled length into fixed buffer

cves.name: wpa_supplicant P2P SSID overflow
cves.impact: Heap overflow via SSID IE length during P2P discovery
cves.root_cause: memcpy(buf, ie->ssid, ie->ssid_len) without length validation against 32-byte max

cves.name: Windows WiFi Driver Stack Overflow
cves.impact: Remote Code Execution with kernel privileges
cves.root_cause: Stack buffer overflow; WiFi driver copies SSID using attacker-controlled length from beacon frame
cves.affected_versions: All Windows 10/11/Server prior to June 2024 patch

cves.name: MediaTek wappd OOB Write
cves.root_cause: Out-of-bounds write in MediaTek WiFi daemon during frame processing

cves.name: FreeBSD net80211 Mesh ID Overflow
cves.impact: Remote Code Execution with kernel privileges
cves.root_cause: Heap overflow via Mesh ID IE (structurally identical to SSID IE) with oversized Length field

cves.name: Realtek RTL8195A Stack Overflow
cves.impact: Remote Code Execution, no password required
cves.root_cause: Stack buffer overflow during WiFi authentication handshake

cves.name: Marvell Avastar Block Pool Overflow
cves.impact: Code execution on WiFi co-processor during background scan
cves.root_cause: Block pool overflow during chipset automatic 5-minute background scan

cves.name: Tenda AC1206 SSID Stack Overflow
cves.impact: Stack-based buffer overflow via SSID parameter
cves.root_cause: sprintf(buf, 'iwpriv ra0 set SSID=%s', ssid) without length check

cves.name: WiFiDemon (iOS wifid format string)
cves.impact: Zero-click RCE via SSID format string; wormable
cves.root_cause: syslog(LOG_INFO, ssid) instead of syslog(LOG_INFO, "%s", ssid); SSID used as format argument

cves.name: D-Link DAP-X1860 SSID Command Injection
cves.root_cause: SSID passed to system() call during scan processing without sanitization

cves.name: Circle with Disney SSID Command Injection
cves.root_cause: parse_ap_list passes SSID to system() without sanitization

cves.name: Circle with Disney sed injection
cves.impact: Command injection via sed command with SSID
cves.root_cause: SSID interpolated into sed command string; shell metacharacters break out

cves.name: Node.js systeminformation SSID injection
cves.impact: Command injection via exec() in wifiConnections()
cves.root_cause: wifiConnections() passes SSID to exec() without sanitization

cves.name: Trendnet TEW-831DR SSID XSS
cves.impact: XSS via SSID in Site Survey page
cves.root_cause: SSID rendered into HTML without escaping <, >, " characters

cves.name: TP-Link WR841N SSID XSS
cves.root_cause: Unescaped SSID rendered in HTML scan results page

cves.name: Log4Shell (JNDI via SSID logging)
cves.impact: Remote Code Execution via JNDI lookup in logged SSID
cves.root_cause: logger.info('Detected AP: ' + ssid) with Log4j resolving ${jndi:ldap://...} in message
